quickhack.chromeware.short_circuit.descr: Deals true damage. Mechanical mobs take more. Disables enemy implants for 3 seconds. Adds 3s duration to all control quickhacks currently affecting the target. Deals bonus damage against players with high implants.
quickhack.chromeware.overheat.descriptio: Sets the enemy on fire, reduces armor by 40% and enemy takes 20% more damage as fire damage.
quickhack.chromeware.contagion.descripti: Infects the enemy, dealing poison damage. Can spread to 4 extra entities within 8 block radius, dealing 15% extra damage per. Taking fire damage causes an explosion. Mechanical mobs are immune.
quickhack.chromeware.synapse_burnout.des: Deal damage that increases by 10% per RAM unit currently spent (max +400%), damage bonus is doubled during Overclock. -2 RAM cost (stackable) and +3s Overclock duration after killing an enemy.
quickhack.chromeware.reboot_optics.descr: Blinds the target, greatly reducing accuracy and resetting targeting. Killing said target replenishes 3 RAM and spreads the quickhack to the nearest entity.
quickhack.chromeware.weapon_glitch.descr: Detonates the target's ranged weapon and reduces their accuracy.
quickhack.chromeware.cripple_movement.de: Disables movement and movement implants. Affected take 15% more melee damage and grant +5% Health and +2 RAM upon death.
quickhack.chromeware.cyberware_malfuncti:
Disables the target's cyberware for 10 seconds and makes them take 15% more damage. Stackable
At 2 stacks, cyberware is disabled until death.
At 3 stacks, deals true damage over time.
At 8 stacks, the target explodes. Quickhack can not be used again on it.
quickhack.chromeware.bait.description:
Lures the target to your location. Using it again lures them back to where they came from.
Players are pinged instead.
quickhack.chromeware.request_backup.desc:
Calls the nearest entity within 30 blocks to come to the target.
When used on a target affected by Bait, up to 5 more come over.
quickhack.chromeware.memory_wipe.descrip: Makes the target forget about you and unable to target you for 5 seconds. Become invisible to target if the target is a player.
quickhack.chromeware.system_collapse.des: Kills the target, without any death messages.
quickhack.chromeware.cyberpsychosis.desc:
Induces cyberpsychosis in the target for 20 seconds, causing them to attack other entities. Kills themselves if no target is near.
+40% duration and +40% damage taken for each other quickhack currently affecting the target.
quickhack.chromeware.detonate_grenade.de:
Force explodes a suitable explosive item/block in a target/contraption. Can also ignite explosive blocks/entities.
-15 RAM cost for 3 seconds after exploding anything.
quickhack.chromeware.suicide.description:
Makes the target kill themselves.
-10 RAM cost for 30 seconds after killing an enemy with melee
+20% Health after killing the target with the quickhack.
quickhack.chromeware.blackwall_gateway.d:
This quickhack spreads to 3 enemies within 20 blocks, causing lethal damage.
Automatically consumes RAM every time it spreads, with each spread having a shorter upload time and a higher RAM cost than the last.
quickhack.chromeware.remote_activation.d: Manipulates basic redstone functions, such as opening/closing doors and activating/deactivating lamps.

chromeware.ponder.surgery_installation.h: Installing cyberware with a Mechanical Arm
chromeware.ponder.surgery_installation.t: Before placing the Mechanical Arm, select the stock Depot.
Select the chair as a yellow input.
Place the arm within reach and power it
Put the implant on the Depot.
Sit down and open Cyberware (B by default). Go to the section implant is for and install it.
The Arm will put the implant for you and remove the flesh limb if necessary.
The implant is fitted. If you want your biological limb back, drink regeneration potions.
